title: 030 - Name Initials
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print the initials SS in uppercase and prints exactly `SS`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function nameInitials(array $values): string
{
    sort($values);
    return implode(",", $values);
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function nameInitials(array $values): string
{
    rsort($values);
    return implode(",", $values);
}
hint: Use uppercase letters after taking the initials.
explanation: The broken code builds lowercase initials. Converting the result to uppercase fixes the output.
